about.heading: About me
paragraphs: I'm a junior software developer specialising in Java/Spring Boot backends and React/TypeScript front ends, with native Android experience in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. At Thales Netherlands I delivered production software used by more than 60 internal stakeholders, and on my own I designed, built and deployed a full-stack AI application, from the Android client to the cloud API.

Before software I spent six years as a personal trainer. That client-facing work taught me to listen carefully, explain complex things simply and stay consistent over the long run: habits I bring to code reviews, stand-ups and pairing sessions.

I care about clean, tested code: SOLID, Clean Architecture, meaningful test suites and CI pipelines that catch regressions before they reach users. I'm available immediately and hold EU citizenship, so no visa or sponsorship is required.

bullets: Improved reporting data accuracy by 25% for 60+ internal stakeholders by designing and shipping a Value Stream Mapping project-management tool built on Java/Spring Boot with a React/TypeScript frontend.
Raised backend test coverage to 95% by building unit and integration test suites with JUnit 5 and Mockito, protecting core business logic against regressions.
Cut frontend development time for new modules by ~15% by engineering a reusable React/TypeScript component and hooks library.
Automated testing and static analysis on every commit by integrating Jenkins and SonarQube CI/CD pipelines, enforcing quality gates before merge.
Client-facing role prior to transitioning into software development: coaching, clear communication and long-term accountability with dozens of clients.

hybridAi.summary: An Android app that generates personalised multi-week training plans with Google Gemini, backed by a Node.js API deployed on Render with MongoDB Atlas.
hybridAi.problem: Generic training plans don't adapt to a person's goals, equipment or schedule. I wanted an app that produces a genuinely personalised plan from user data and keeps working without connectivity.
hybridAi.solution: A native Android client (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Clean Architecture, MVVM, Hilt, Room, Retrofit) talking to a Node.js/Express REST API that proxies every call to Gemini, persists plans in MongoDB Atlas and is secured with JWT and Google Sign-In.

decisions.title: Offline-first persistence
decisions.text: Room caches plans on the device, so the app works without connectivity and syncs when it's back online.

decisions.title: Secrets never reach the client
decisions.text: Every AI call goes through the backend. API keys and prompts stay on the server, behind a versioned response schema.

decisions.title: Deterministic AI output
decisions.text: Gemini is called with a JSON response schema and exponential-backoff retries, turning free-form LLM text into structured data the app can trust.

decisions.title: Safeguarded releases
decisions.text: Automated Jest test suites and Trivy security scanning run before every deployment.

architecture.diagramLabel: Architecture diagram: the Android app calls the Node.js API over HTTPS with a JWT; the API calls Google Gemini with a JSON schema and stores plans and users in MongoDB Atlas.
